topic: Booking Cat Boarding at the Vet Clinic for Holiday

script.title: CAT BOARDING WEEK
script.scene_zh: 獸醫診所 · 預訂寄宿
script.story_hook: The cat packs first, the human panics later.
script.intro_zh: 貓先收拾妥當，主人到最後才慌張。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the clinic boarding desk. Listen for pet-care booking phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到診所寄宿櫃台。留意寵物住宿相關的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's Dumpling all sorted for the holiday. Listen again and repeat out loud.
script.outro_zh: 水餃的假期住宿就這樣安排妥當。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line together now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a tidy woman in her thirties with her black hair pulled into a low clip at the nape, thin gold earrings, a denim jacket over a white tee, a small crossbody purse, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a calm man in his forties with sandy blond hair swept off his forehead, square glasses, a teal clinic polo shirt, a visitor badge clipped to his pocket, and a tall broad build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to book boarding for my cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ˈbɔɹdɪŋ fɚ maɪ kæt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想幫我家的貓預約寄宿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help. When do you need the dates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp wɛn du ju nid ðə deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 很樂意幫忙。您需要哪幾天的寄宿？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: December twentieth to the thirty-first.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈsɛmbɚ ˈtwɛnɾi tə ðə ˈθɝɾi fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 十二月二十日到三十一日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ooh, holiday week, you called at the perfect time.
dialogue.phonetic: /u hɑləˌweɪ wik ju kɔld æt ðə ˈpɝfɪkt taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那是假期那一週，您這通電話打得正是時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right? Last year three clinics had no room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt læst jɪɹ θɹi ˈklɪnɪks hæd noʊ ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，去年有三間診所都客滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep two quiet rooms upstairs, plus regular cages.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip tu kwaɪət ɹumz ˌʌpˈstɛɹz plʌs ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ keɪdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 我們樓上有兩間安靜房，另外是一般籠位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, what's the difference for the cat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌts ðə ˈdɪfɹəns fɚ ðə kæt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，對貓來說差別是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rooms cost more, but shy cats do way better there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹumz kɔst mɔɹ bʌt ʃaɪ kæts du weɪ ˈbɛɾɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 房間比較貴，但膽小的貓在那邊會適應好很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine hides under the bed when guests come.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn haɪdz ˈʌndɚ ðə bɛd wɛn ɡɛsts kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我家那隻一有客人就躲到床底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a room, honestly, no question about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ɹum ˈɑnəstli noʊ ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就選房間，老實說，這毫無疑問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, um, his name is Dumpling, silly, I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ʌm hɪz neɪm ɪz ˈdʌmplɪŋ ˈsɪli aɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，牠叫水餃，名字很逗，我知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dumpling, I love it already. Is he friendly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌmplɪŋ aɪ lʌv ɪt ɔlˈɹɛdi ɪz hi ˈfɹɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 水餃，我已經喜歡這名字了。牠親人不親人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To me, yes. To strangers, full disaster.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə mi jɛs tə ˈstɹeɪndʒɚz fʊl dɪˈsæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對我很撒嬌，對陌生人整個崩潰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, slow introductions. Now, paperwork time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt sloʊ ˌɪntrəˈdəkʃənz naʊ ˈpeɪpɚwɑrk taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 了解，要慢慢讓牠習慣。接下來是文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need his vaccination record, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju nid hɪz ˌvæksəˈneɪʃən ˈɹɛkɚd ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你們需要牠的疫苗接種紀錄，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the shot certificate from Dr. Lee's clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ʃɑt səɹˈtɪfəkət fɹəm ˈdɑkɾɚ lɪz ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對，是李醫生那邊開的施打證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the paper copy lives at my apartment.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈkɑpi lɪvz æt maɪ ˈəɹˌpɑɹtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，紙本證明放在我租屋處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, email a photo tonight, we'll print it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ˈimeɪl ə ˈfoʊtoʊ təˈnaɪt wil prɪnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，今晚先傳一張照片過來，我們會列印好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that saves me a whole extra drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt seɪvz mi ə hoʊl ˈɛkstrə dɹaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那就省得我專程再跑一趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next, food. Can you bring his usual brand?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst fud kən ju brɪŋ hɪz ˈjuʒuəl brænd/
dialogue.zh: 接著是食物，可以帶牠平常吃的飼料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, um, one bag is already packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌm wʌn bæɡ ɪz ɔlˈɹɛdi pækt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，嗯，牠那袋乾糧我已經收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Wet food too, or just the crunchy kind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt wɛt fud tu ɔɹ dʒʌst ðə ˈkrʌnʃi kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。濕糧也要嗎，還是只要乾的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He eats wet only at dinner, one small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi its wɛt ˈoʊnli æt ˈdɪnɚ wʌn smɔl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 牠只有晚餐吃濕糧，一小杯就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, seven p.m. dinner, same as home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊɾɪd ˈsɛvən ˌpiˈɛm ˈdɪnɚ seɪm æz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，晚上七點晚餐，跟在家一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. One more thing, and this part is tricky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ænd ðɪs pɑɹt ɪz ˈtɹɪki/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。還有一件事，有點麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me guess, medicine?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛs ˈmɛdəsɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我猜猜，牠每天要吃藥？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know? Yes, one pill, morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ jɛs wʌn pɪl ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼知道？對，早上一顆藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hide it in a treat, works most days.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi haɪd ɪt ɪn ə tɹit wɝks moʊst deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們會把藥藏在零食裡，多數時候都有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? At home he spits it out instantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiəli æt hoʊm hi spɪts ɪt aʊt ˈɪnstəntli/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？牠在家一下就把藥吐出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, cats are judges. Our staff is bribable.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ kæts ɑɹ ˈdʒʌdʒəz ˈaʊɚ stæf ɪz ˈbraɪəbəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，貓天生愛評判。我們這邊的夥伴比較好收買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the most confident thing I've heard today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə moʊst ˈkɑnfədənt θɪŋ aɪv hɝd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，這是今天聽到最有氣勢的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I rehearse daily. Room one is free those dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɹiˈhɝs ˈdeɪli ɹum wʌn ɪz fri ðoʊz deɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我每天都在練習。那幾天一號房剛好是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is room one near anything loud? Like vacuums?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɹum wʌn nɪɹ ˈɛniθɪŋ laʊd laɪk ˈvækˌjumz/
dialogue.zh: 一號房會靠近吵的地方嗎？例如吸塵器？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart question, no, it's at the very back hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈkwɛstʃən noʊ ɪs æt ðə ˈvɛɹi bæk hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 問得好，不會，它就在走廊最深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, he sleeps in odd places anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt hi sleeps ɪn ɑd ˈpleɪsəz ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，反正牠什麼奇怪地方都能睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, pricing: the room is forty a night.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈpɹaɪsɪŋ ðə ɹum ɪz ˈfɔɹti ə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那費用方面，房間一晚四十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For eleven nights, um, four hundred forty, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ɪˈlɛvən naɪts ʌm fɔɹ ˈhʌndɹəd ˈfɔɹti ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十一晚，嗯，四百四十，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're quick, yes, plus a twenty one-time signup.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ kwɪk jɛs plʌs ə ˈtwɛnti ˈwaɪnˌtaɪm ˈsaɪnˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 您算得快。對，再加二十塊的一次註冊費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, can I pay today by card?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm kən aɪ peɪ təˈdeɪ baɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我今天可以直接刷卡付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half today, half at drop-off, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf təˈdeɪ hæf æt ˈdɹɑp ɔf ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 今天付一半，送來時再付一半，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, fair. Can I visit him once?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ fɛɹ kən aɪ ˈvɪzɪt hɪm wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 好，合理。我可以去看牠一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Visits confuse cats, trust me, it's kinder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪsəts kənˈfjuz kæts tɹʌst mi ɪts ˈkaɪndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 探視只會讓貓更混亂，相信我，不見面比較溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, okay, my heart agrees, barely.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ oʊˈkeɪ maɪ hɑɹt əˈɡriz ˈbɛɹli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，好吧，我的心勉強點頭同意了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it gets easier around day three.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt ɡɛts ˈiziɚ əˈɹaʊnd deɪ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，第三天左右就會輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I believe you. I'll trust you here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ju aɪl trʌst ju hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我相信你們。這件事就交給你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll text a photo update, just one a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛks ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈʌpˌdeɪt dʒʌst wʌn ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會傳照片更新，一天只傳一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One photo a day is honestly perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ ə deɪ ɪz ˈɑnəstli ˈpɝfɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 一天一張照片，說真的，太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop-off is Monday, we close at seven sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɹɑp ɔf ɪz ˈmʌnˌdeɪ wi kloʊz æt ˈsɛvən ʃɑɹp/
dialogue.zh: 請週一把牠送來，我們七點整關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday works. Oh, the carrier is in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnˌdeɪ wɝks oʊ ðə ˈkɛɾiɚ ɪz ɪn maɪ kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 週一可以。噢，我的外出籠放在車上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we'll walk out and grab it together.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz wil wɔk aʊt ænd ɡɹæb ɪt təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我們會走出來跟您一起搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Um, do I need a harness for that walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʌm du aɪ nid ə ˈhɑɹnəs fɚ ðæt wɔk/
dialogue.zh: 好。嗯，那段路我需要牽繩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cats freeze better in carriers, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæts friz ˈbɛɾɚ ɪn ˈkɛɾiɚz ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，貓待在外出籠裡比較不會僵住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll just bring the whole box then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl dʒʌst brɪŋ ðə hoʊl bɑks ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就把整個籠子直接帶進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple. Last thing: any favorite hiding spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl læst θɪŋ ˈɛni ˈfeɪvɚɪt ˈhaɪdɪŋ spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 簡單。最後一件事：牠有喜歡的躲藏位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cardboard boxes, um, the flappier the better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑɹdˌbɔɹd ˈbɑksəz ʌm ðə ˈflæpiɚ ðə ˈbɛɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 紙箱，嗯，越搖晃的那種越好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, noted, box number one, the flappy kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾɪd bɑks ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn ðə ˈflæpi kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，記下了，第一箱，搖晃款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. This feels weirdly organized already.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðɪs filz ˈwɪɹdli ˈɔɹɡəˌnaɪzd ɔlˈɹɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 好了。沒想到一切都安排得妥妥當當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our job, make chaos feel calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑɹ dʒɑb meɪk ˈkeɪˌɑs fil kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們的工作，把混亂變得平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You people are wizards, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈpipəl ɑɹ ˈwɪɹdz θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你們都是魔法師，太感謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, bye Dumpling, see you Monday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ baɪ ˈdʌmplɪŋ si ju ˈmʌnˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，再見了水餃，週一早上見。

script.youtube_title: 【節前幫貓找住宿🐈】「把混亂變得平靜」診所寄宿預約全流程🏥🎧｜聽完就能自己打電話｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Cat Boarding at the Vet
script.youtube_title_en: "Make Chaos Feel Calm" — Booking Cat Boarding at the Vet Clinic
script.youtube_description:
「把混亂變得平靜」——放假前要出門，貓的寄宿到底怎麼訂？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在獸醫診所的寄宿櫃台。

你會聽到：報出日期、詢問安靜房與一般籠位的差別；紙本疫苗證明不在身邊時怎麼用郵件補；餵藥、晚餐時間、特殊飲食怎麼交代；還有訂金規矩、探視建議、送貓時間與關門時間的完整問答。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人日常對話的真實語感：um、so、ha、honestly。聽完你就會用：I'd like to book...、No problem, email a photo、That's the rule、I'll text a photo update。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Make chaos feel calm" — how do you book vet-clinic boarding for your cat before the holidays? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the clinic front desk.

You will hear: giving exact dates, comparing quiet rooms with regular cages, emailing a vaccination photo when the paper is far away, explaining dinner time and morning pills, and sorting the deposit rule, visit advice, and drop-off details.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans actually use: um, honestly, wow, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like I'd like to book..., That's the rule, and I'll text a photo update.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene soon.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
假期要出遠門，貓要送到哪裡才安心？安靜房跟一般籠位差在哪？紙本疫苗證明還放在租屋處，怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進獸醫診所的寄宿櫃台，從報日期、挑房型，到交代餵藥與晚餐時間、談訂金規矩，一路聽到接送安排與道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🐈 開場預約：Hi, I'd like to book boarding for my cat.
💉 補文件：No problem, email a photo tonight, we'll print it.
💊 交代餵藥：How did you know? Yes, one pill, morning.
🚗 送貓細節：Monday works. Oh, the carrier is in my car.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、wow、honestly 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著把水餃安頓好，下次自己打電話訂寄宿，話自然從嘴邊冒出來。

祝你和貓咪都有一個安心的假期。
